text:
carla: Heads up — main CI is failing across the integration matrix, lots of tests tripping on DB errors.
ci-bot: Job `integration-x86` failed: exit code 1. Logs available: https://ci.internal/build/1791234567
dmitri: quick skim — most failures are `psql: could not open file /var/lib/postgresql/data/PG_VERSION: No such file or directory` from the mock-db pod
ana: same here locally when I ran the job in the cluster, the mock-db pod shows the PV unbound and then pod restarted.
carla: repro log snippet:
```
postgres  | FATAL:  data directory "//var/lib/postgresql/data" has wrong ownership
kubectl  | Warning: volumeClaim "mock-db-pvc" is not bound
```
dmitri: suspect the ephemeral volume detaches during node reboots/eviction. We've seen velero restoring mounts in dev but not in CI nodes.
ana: @ops-bot can you check if there were any recent node taints or preemptions in the `ci-builders` autoscaling group around the failing timestamps?
ops-bot: detected 2 spot-preemptions on ci-builders-7 and ci-builders-9 within the last 15m. PVCs were deleted as part of pod eviction policy on those nodes.
carla: ok that explains the missing PG files. For now can we mark the affected integration tests as flaky or add a short retry wrapper? Prefer minimal blast radius.
dmitri: I'm going to open a quick PR to add a `--retry 2` wrapper for the flaky DB tests and an issue to fix PVC reclaimPolicy. Ping me for review.
ana: also pushing a mitigation — switch mock-db PVC reclaimPolicy from Delete to Retain for ci cluster images. Will notify infra-for-ci.
dmitri: rolled a temporary change: `ci-k8s: set pvc.reclaimPolicy=Retain` in the k8s job template and triggered manual rerun.
ci-bot: Rerun triggered: https://ci.internal/build/1791234588
carla: rerun looks greener but still 2 failing jobs that hit different nodes. Those show `i/o timeout` when mounting. Might be networking flakiness.
dmitri: let's bisect — can somebody run `ci-runner` against a single failing test on the suspected node pool? If it's repro on node pool A but not B we can pin.
ana: starting a targeted run on `ci-builders-3` now, will post results.
ops-bot: targeted run completed on ci-builders-3: PASSED. ci-builders-9 targeted run: FAILED (PV mount i/o timeout).
carla: conclusion: node pool 9 has intermittent storage attach issues. I've opened infra ticket INFRA-3421 and linked the failing job logs.
dmitri: until INFRA-3421 is fixed, I propose: 1) skip heavy PV-dependent tests on node pool 9 by scheduling them on pool 3; 2) keep the retry wrapper for 24h.
ana: agreed. I'll add a nodeSelector in CI job config and update the prow/runner.k8s job templates.
carla: thanks all — setting the thread to follow-up. If infra fixes the attach logic we revert the nodeSelector and the retry.
ci-bot: Note: flaky label applied to 6 tests in the matrix. :warning:
carla: FYI for release managers: this may block nightly canary if not mitigated. I'll post an update in #incidents once INFRA-3421 has a fix plan.
